subject: Shortburst patch activation and customer advisory
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: operations@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2029 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Immediate: shortburst patch activation plan

Team,

We just observed sustained memory growth (heap + native) on a small subset of Dedicated inference pods handling long-chat sessions. Metric spikes started ~07:50 PST and are trending upward on the 95th percentile for a handful of tenants. No immediate data exfiltration or correctness regressions detected.

Proposed immediate action (T+20m):
- Deploy micro-quant hotfix (hotfix_microquant_v1.patch) to runtime on a 5% canary subset in us-west-2 (canary targeting tenants with long-session patterns).
- Enable short-lived circuit-breaker config (eviction threshold backstop) for canary.
- Monitor 1min token latency, memory RSS, and error rates; rollback on >3x baseline 5xx or prolonged latency >300ms for >5m.

Customer comms: I recommend a concise advisory to the small set of affected accounts (FinCloud first) with a 15-minute window and a note about brief connection resets (expected <60s) as we perform a rolling restart. Attach runbook and patch.

Attachments: shortburst_runbook.pdf (ops play), hotfix_microquant_v1.patch (patch artifact)

Please ACK and call out any runbook gaps now. I will assemble the external advisory once we agree.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sr. Incident Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2029 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate: shortburst patch activation plan

Ack. Good call on canary. A couple of quick asks before we push:
- Ensure the runbook includes the explicit rollback tag and the kube selector for fast rollback.
- Apply circuit-breaker and reduced batch sizes for canary. If memory growth persists after 2 roll cycles (10m each), escalate to full rollback.
- Notify legal/CS if FinCloud is impacted more than once—we may need an SLA exception note.

Jordan — please include a one-line customer-facing explanation and the exact window. Ben, please stand by for canary verification (smoke freqs). Marissa, prep support channel and escalation template.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bates <tim.bates@fincloud.com>, ops@fincloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2029 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Brief advisory: short maintenance window for targeted micro-patch (FinCloud)

Hi Tim / FinCloud ops team,

Quick note from Redwood: our on-call detected a memory-growth pattern impacting a small subset of inference workers that can cause elevated latency for very long chats. We will be applying a targeted micro-patch to the serving runtime to reduce memory pressure.

Window: 09:00 - 09:15 PST (rolling, us-west-2). Expected user-facing impact: transient connection resets during rolling restarts (each affected connection may see a brief interruption, typically <60s). No model behavior changes expected.

What we ask from you: no action required unless you see persistent errors after 09:30 PST. If you do, reply to this thread and we will prioritize a rollback and deeper dive.

We will post continuous updates to status.redwood.ai and follow up with a short postmortem once we've stabilized. Runbook and technical snapshot attached.

Attachments: customer-snapshot.txt (short telemetry snippet)
Runbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/shortburst-runbook-20291102
Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2029-1102

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Incident Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Tim Bates <tim.bates@fincloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fincloud.com
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2029 08:45:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Brief advisory: short maintenance window for targeted micro-patch (FinCloud)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads up. We will monitor and let you know immediately if we see persistent errors. Please ping here when the patch completes and if you recommend any client-side retries.

Best,
Tim
Tim Bates
Head of Platform Engineering, FinCloud
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2029 09:12:37 -0800
Subject: Deploy complete; short follow-up and next steps

Quick update — canary deploy finished at 09:05 PST, roll to the remaining 5% slice completed by 09:12 PST. Observations:
- Memory RSS for canary pods dropped ~22% median within 2 minutes post-restart.
- No 5xx spike; transient connection resets recorded as expected (peak ~35s).
- FinCloud samples show restored latency to baseline by 09:10 PST.

Action items:
- Marissa: please send an outbound follow-up to FinCloud with the telemetry snapshot and note that a full postmortem will be sent within 48 hours.
- Ben: run the smoke script on the affected selector and paste results into the incident doc.
- Rishi: I'll start the 48h postmortem draft and include a remediation PR for the serving runtime to address the allocation pattern.
